visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a professional television studio. A man with a short haircut wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt and beige pants sits at a wooden mahjong table. Opposite him sits an older man in a light grey suit. Behind them, four young women stand as assistants or guests; one wears a white off-the-shoulder dress, another a blue dress, a third in denim, and a fourth in white. The background features large purple and blue vertical banners with gold calligraphy. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor temple environment. The same man in the blue shirt stands before a golden altar, holding thin incense sticks with both hands. He closes his eyes in a gesture of prayer. The lighting is warm and comes from artificial lamps illuminating the intricate gold textures of the temple walls. (3) A close-up shot shows a wooden counter lined up with several white paper cups featuring ornate blue and gold circular lids. Behind them are boxes and straws, suggesting a catering setup for a film crew. (4) In a room with vibrant red walls and dark ceilings, the man in the blue shirt checks a gold-colored wristwatch on his left wrist. He smiles broadly at the camera, gesturing with his right hand as if explaining the time. (5) Back on the studio set, the older man, now wearing an orange blazer, stands beside a woman in a brown patterned dress. They are reviewing gameplay or talking to the man in the blue shirt, who stands nearby looking attentive. The studio lighting is bright and even. (6) A montage of the mahjong game follows. The man in the blue shirt sits at the table, his expression shifting from intense focus to visible frustration. Close-up shots capture the white and green mahjong tiles being shuffled and discarded on the wooden surface. (7) The final phase shows the man in the blue shirt standing in front of the purple studio backdrop. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face, eventually turning to walk away as if concluding the vlog episode.
